name: infracare
description: InfraCare – build frontend then serve everything through a single FastAPI process on :8000

scripts.kill: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Port 8000 cleared'"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run kill && npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.start:dev: npm run kill && cd backend && .venv\Scripts\uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
